column4: Directory existence selects persistent-like versus volatile behavior; explanatory paragraph preserves early-boot/unwritable fallback and compiled-default distinction.
10% and 15% defaults each capped 4G; accompanying explanation explicitly qualifies smaller allowance with startup floor.
Corrected to saturated subtraction at 168, clamp at 170, and available growth at 171; no longer states min(free,keep_free).
MAX raises minimum to at least current usage; startup/first-open and reset-on-restart wording matches source comment without claiming exclusive startup callsite.
One-eighth default capped 128M, usually seven retained rotated files, compact-mode 4G ceiling; no guaranteed seven-file claim.
Default 100 and archived-only deletions supported; active files can leave total above configured count.
Corrected rate assignments at 51-52; sync and max-file fallback merges at 133 and 142; all four constant values hold.
Vacuum-size removes oldest archives, disk-usage includes active journals, and rotate-first combination is correctly qualified.
